note: YACL sent_actions is a Send() count, not round depth. CSV values are the three-party sum.

yacl.chunked_http: one action per logical Send, not per fragment (http_max_payload_size=1MiB; our AND payloads are <<1MiB)

bench.aggregation: sum of the three parties over the timed kernel (warmup excluded)
bench.includes_spdzwise_commit: prepareOutputs + guard.commit sit inside the timer, so ABFL/MAC for a2b is included

spdzwise.remaining_are: MAC check, ABFL, Boolean open, AllGather/RequireAll (2 Sends per AllGather in 1 round)
spdzwise.adder: ripple-carry (not Kogge-Stone); batch 2048 packs into 32 64-bit words so round depth is independent of n

aby3_exact.adder: ppa_kogge_stone; vmap packs the two ANDs per KS level into one and_bb

a2b_2048_fm64_spdzwise.note: a2b() does not verify; prepareOutputs/commit runs ABFL

wall_clock_reconciliation.interpretation: BRPC ~1ms spends ~192 ping RTTs, matching ~189 sequential AND rounds. 867 is 3x over-count vs per-party Sends (289) and is not the round count. Ratio 15x is the ripple vs Kogge-Stone gap, not a counter bug.
